title: OpenAI takes an ownership stake in Thrive Holdings to accelerate enterprise AI adoption
summary: OpenAI takes an ownership stake in Thrive Holdings to accelerate enterprise AI adoption, embedding frontier research and engineering directly into accounting and IT services to boost speed, accuracy, and efficiency while creating a scalable model for industry-wide transformation.
body: OpenAI takes an ownership stake in Thrive Holdings to accelerate enterprise AI adoption, embedding frontier research and engineering directly into accounting and IT services to boost speed, accuracy, and efficiency while creating a scalable model for industry-wide transformation.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布收购Thrive Holdings股权，旨在加速企业级AI的深度落地。通过将前沿模型研究与工程能力直接嵌入会计及IT服务领域，双方计划构建一套可扩展的行业转型模型，以显著提升企业运营效率、数据处理速度及准确性，为传统行业数字化转型提供新的范式参考。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI通过资本手段深度介入垂直行业，是其企业级AI落地战略的重要信号。

glossary.explanationZh: 面向企业级业务场景的AI应用与集成方案。
指处于行业最前沿的AI模型研发与技术探索。
指具备可复制性和规模化推广能力的业务或技术模型。
